objective: Independently review the owner-approved Filamajig NFC M7 Full Spectrum foundation for architectural integrity, Android and Room compatibility, failure modes, evidence fidelity, and regressions in established NFC and portable identity behavior.
owner_requirements: Add canonical richer transmission-distance and optical characterization with explicit provenance, uncertainty, method, geometry, thickness, environmental, instrument, confidence, and supersession fields
Add extensible appearance and Full Spectrum role assertions with canonical C, M, Y, G mixing roles and White and Black anchors
Keep recommended suitability distinct from observed suitability and preserve UNKNOWN and UNTESTED without automatic numeric TD thresholds
Use an additive Room user database v5-to-v6 migration, retain compatibility tables, copy valid legacy TD once, and quarantine malformed legacy TD without promoting it to numeric evidence
Expose Full Spectrum only through progressive disclosure on saved local profiles
Preserve existing Standard OpenSpool and PAXX payload bytes and portable identity v1
Do not implement sets, recipes, automatic best-set scoring, private NFC fields, or slicer project generation
change_summary: Added typed M7 core domain vocabulary and validation for TD origins, optical characterization, appearances, roles, authorities, assertion states, suitability kinds, ratings, and scopes
Added six Room v6 evidence and Full Spectrum tables with profile/evidence foreign keys, query indices, assessment scope check, DAO reads and writes, and an exported v6 schema

Added additive v5-to-v6 migration that retains legacy tables, conservatively maps legacy origins, copies valid 0.1-to-100 decimal TD values, and retains malformed values only as quarantined non-TD optical evidence
Made optical_characterizations authoritative for post-v6 TD writes while leaving transmission_distance_measurements read-only for rollback and export compatibility
Added repository APIs for aggregate profile reads, user-confirmed role assertions, and observed suitability
Added collapsed Full Spectrum profile UI with explicit local-only boundary, unknown and untested states, conflict-visible TD evidence, roles, and separate recommended and observed suitability
Kept codec and portable identity source unchanged from baseline 0dac497b4
TD replacement and clearing now supersede every prior active TD characterization transactionally; a clear writes a null tombstone so the effective UI state is Unknown without erasing history
Persistence uses layer_height_mm consistently with the approved layerHeightMm domain contract

objective_evidence.protected_host_validation: PASS: heavy-gradle core tests, app tests, lintDebug, debug APK, unsigned release APK, and debug Android-test APK; 66 core plus 71 app tests, zero failures
objective_evidence.database_runtime: PASS on connected Android 16 device: existing app database opened at user_version 6, integrity_check ok, foreign_key_check empty, and all six M7 tables present
objective_evidence.exact_2023_device: PENDING: the currently USB-connected phone identifies as motorola razr 2026; the discovered motorola razr 2023 wireless endpoint did not accept its saved ADB connection and exact-model tests correctly refused to claim evidence

known_limits: Exact motorola razr 2023 acceptance remains pending because that device is not currently connected; current artifact installation and database-runtime checks used a motorola razr 2026 on Android 16

M7 records user-confirmed profile roles and profile-level observed suitability; role-specific assessment UI and richer optical capture controls are intentionally limited to the approved foundation scope
No automatic suitability policy exists, so recommended suitability remains UNKNOWN unless future reviewed policy evidence is added
review_questions: Can malformed, zero, out-of-range, missing, duplicated, or conflicting legacy TD data be promoted, lost, or silently selected during v5-to-v6 migration or later saves?
Do domain validation, Room schema, migration behavior, DAO APIs, and UI terminology represent the same origin, role category, assertion state, suitability kind, rating, and scope contracts?
Can repeated role or suitability actions create misleading active duplicates, ID collisions, cross-profile references, or false current-state displays?
Does the progressive-disclosure UI accurately preserve unknown, untested, conflicting, recommended, observed, local-only, and catalog-unsaved states without implying automatic scoring?
Is any M7 evidence serialized into OpenSpool, PAXX, portable identity v1, Spoolman export, labels, or another compatibility boundary contrary to scope?
Does the migration remain additive and safe for empty, v4-to-v5-to-v6, direct v5-to-v6, shared-profile, deleted-record, rollback/export, and foreign-key scenarios?
sanitization: No credentials, environment values, private database contents, NFC UIDs, device serials, network addresses, account data, or reviewer output are included.
